newsitem.title: ISRAEL: RESEARCH ALERT - Lehman keeps ECI buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Lehman keeps ECI buy.

text.p: Lehman Brothers said it was maintaining its 1-Buy recommendation for ECI Telecom, saying business in the third quarter appears to be on track.
"The company indicated that the flow of business has been healthy thus far in the quarter," Lehman said in a report it issued after speaking to ECI management.

"While we are assuming a modest 13 percent improvement in third-quarter EPS year over year, the generally upbeat appraisal of the business has given us greater confidence that ECI is poised for an acceleration in earnings momentum in the fourth quarter and continuing through 1997," the report said.
Lehman also believes ECI is close to finalising a long awaited Ji Tong contract in China. ECI's portion of the business is valued at $45 million.
"We believe that the Israel to China government financing package is largely in place and that a final announcement could be made soon," the Lehman report said.
"Assuming this business comes in as planned, we believe EPS in the fourth quarter will increase 29 percent to $0.40." It estimated EPS in all of 1997 will rise 25 percent to $1.73.
